title: Advance causal completion recovery past a malformed retained custody row
outcome: A malformed or oversized retained custody row is visibly refused without permanently pinning the recovery cursor or preventing later valid originals in either table from being examined.
acceptance: A behavioral test places malformed custody before a valid original and observes later valid work reached while the malformed request remains uncredited.
The row/page/keyset visit and result bounds, alternating-table fairness, and authority/source validation remain intact.
